versions.changelog:
Initial release of agent-team-orchestration-local-backup.

- Launches a playbook for orchestrating multi-agent teams with well-defined roles and workflows.
- Supports task routing, lifecycle management (inbox → spec → build → review → done), and explicit handoff protocols.
- Provides guidelines for spawning tasks, setting artifact output paths, and implementing review and quality gates.
- Offers reference documentation and checklists for defining roles, managing state, and troubleshooting common pitfalls.
- Clarifies when to use (multi-agent, recurring team workflows) and when not to use (single-agent or simple delegation) this skill.
